subsection.name: Where
subsection.p: Intercontinental Miami, Miami, Florida, alongside ApacheCon NA 2017.

subsection.name: What
subsection.p: TomcatCon is the place for all users of Tomcat to expand their Tomcat knowledge in areas such as networking, security, performance and deployment. It also offers an opportunity to discuss the current Tomcat roadmap and help inform future development.
Access to TomcatCon is included with ApacheCon registration.
Interested in submitting to speak at TomcatCon? Submit your talk idea to the ApacheCon CFP by February 11, and be sure to note "Tomcat" in the Target Audience field.

subsection.name: Schedule
subsection.p: The schedule will be finalised in early March. The planning is based around the following outline schedule:
